description: Defines the ChangedTransactionDetail class which manages a list of TransactionChangeData objects, representing changes to loan transactions such as reversals or creations, with methods to add, insert before existing, and remove transaction changes.

classes.name: ChangedTransactionDetail
classes.description: Manages a list of transaction changes related to loan transactions, allowing addition, insertion before existing changes, and removal.

methods.name: addTransactionChange
methods.description: Adds a TransactionChangeData to the list, updating existing entries if matching old or new transaction IDs.

methods.name: addNewTransactionChangeBeforeExistingOne
methods.description: Inserts a new TransactionChangeData before an existing one associated with a specific LoanTransaction.

methods.name: removeTransactionChange
methods.description: Removes a TransactionChangeData associated with a specific LoanTransaction.
